# What crosses the boundary

Policy: [`migration/export.yaml`](../../migration/export.yaml), decided in [ADR 0003](../adr/0003-hybrid-boundary.md). Every column of every exported object, and what reaches the landing zone. Direct identifiers never cross; indirect ones cross only with the treatment named here.

## Selections

| Relation | Delivered as | Rows of a delivery | Row order |
|---|---|---|---|
| `bronze.corebanking_customer` | `corebanking_customer` | change events of the capture runs of the business date into `bronze.corebanking_customer` | `_kafka_topic`, `_kafka_partition`, `_kafka_offset` |
| `bronze.corebanking_account` | `corebanking_account` | change events of the capture runs of the business date into `bronze.corebanking_account` | `_kafka_topic`, `_kafka_partition`, `_kafka_offset` |
| `bronze.corebanking_card` | `corebanking_card` | change events of the capture runs of the business date into `bronze.corebanking_card` | `_kafka_topic`, `_kafka_partition`, `_kafka_offset` |
| `audit.change_batch` | `change_batch` | change events of the capture runs of the business date into `None` | `run_id`, `topic`, `kafka_partition` |
| `silver.party_member` | `party_member` | the whole table | `customer_id` |
| `bronze.payment_transfer` | `payment_transfer` | `_business_date` = business date | `transfer_id` |
| `bronze.card_transaction` | `card_transaction` | `_business_date` = business date | `txn_ref` |
| `gold.sanctions_hit` | `sanctions_hit` | the whole table | `hit_id` |

## PII gate

Scans every string value of a delivery after the treatments; one match blocks the delivery.

| Detector | Looks for |
|---|---|
| `email` | E-mail address |
| `phone` | Moroccan phone number, national or international form |
| `bank_account` | Moroccan RIB (24 digits) or IBAN (MA and 26 digits) |
| `national_id` | Moroccan national identity card number (CIN): one or two letters and up to six digits |
| `passport` | Passport number: one or two letters and seven or eight digits |
| `card_number` | Payment card number: 13 to 19 digits with a card scheme prefix and a valid Luhn checksum |
| `person_name` | A full name of a customer, as whole words of a value, after normalization (case, accents, punctuation) |

`person_name` uses the names `first_name` + `last_name`, `legal_name` of `restricted.customer_identity`, read at the export's source commit, on premises.

### Exemptions

| Column | Detector | Reason |
|---|---|---|
| `bronze.card_transaction.merchant_id` | `passport` | Card acceptor identifier assigned by the processor (M and seven digits, the shape of a passport number); it identifies a shop, not a person. |
